# Underwriting Memo: Brenvale Grill Holdings

**Risk summary**

Brenvale Grill Holdings operates family restaurants with on-site kitchens and catering services in Jacksonville, FL. The account consists of two locations with total insured value of $5,280,000. Both locations are inland (24.6 km and 27.1 km from coast). The governing class is REST (Restaurant). Broker is Calvetti Insurance (Emerging tier) with a fit score of 80.7.

**Appetite and referral**

This risk is **IN** appetite per **AG-001** (REST is a target class, write up to $12M TIV per account) and **AG-014** (inland Southeast locations acceptable). The account falls well within TIV limits and meets class guidelines. No referral triggers identified.

**Loss history**

Five-year loss history shows favorable performance. One wind damage claim in 2021 incurred $71,600 (paid $63,800, fully closed). No claims reported in 2022-2025. The single weather-related loss does not indicate operational concerns.

**Exposure and concentration**

Both locations contribute to existing portfolio concentration in Jacksonville with $29,750,000 TIV within 25 km radius. Adding $5.28M represents approximately 18% increase to local accumulation. Both sites are inland, mitigating coastal windstorm exposure.

**Recommendation**

Recommend **binding** subject to standard restaurant underwriting requirements. Request kitchen suppression system details and catering operation specifics to confirm proper controls.
